name: _Get Changed Data With Standard Query ( startPosition )
purpose: Builds a QBO query for the records of an entity changed since a timestamp ("SELECT * FROM <Entity> WHERE MetaData.LastUpdatedTime > ... maxresults N startposition N") and sends it through Send QBO Request. Returns the QBO response or an error.
open_question: Step 30 tests $getInActive, a variable no step sets (the option is parsed into $Inactive at step 25), so inactive records are never requested. An empty MaxResults produces "maxresults " with no number. The change-since filter relies on the caller passing lastGetTimeStampUTC. The HTTP call is inside script 18 (Send QBO Request), not here.
